app.title: Show HN: Using 2D DFT, dithering, etc. to maximize eInk manga image quality
app.author: seam_carver
app.description: Command‑line utility to process images for e‑ink displays using 2D DFT and dithering techniques, optimizing contrast and color fidelity.

Benchmark processing time for a 1080p image
